pull_request.title: Calorimeter: restore both ECAL baselines and standalone EDM4hep support
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-baseline-campaign
pull_request.body:
Restores the detailed Si–W and LAr ECAL histories from #70, #71, #73, #74 and #75 directly on current main, together with the scoped hit/cluster EDM4hep plumbing from #80. Closes #114.

Both selectable working baseline packages regenerate the maintained DES043 tracker, compose complete ECAL barrel/endcaps and local services, and record the integrated ID/material namespace. Tracker sources and geometry inputs remain unchanged. The common HCAL, FCAL and solenoid designs retain their separate construction/qualification stages.

Issue114 uses standalone CMake against ACTS355ea684 and existing EDM4hep/podio. Hit/cluster persistence and relations round-trip; digitization/clustering are configuration/I/O skeletons that explicitly fail until physical implementations exist. No toy response, connected-component clustering, jets, upstream hooks, detector relocation or tracker changes are restored.

Validation:32 Si–W controls,28 LAr controls,five composition controls andfour native EDM4hep CTest targets pass. Both current CLI baseline exports pass. Complete native tracker+ECAL overlap audits are running; this PR stays draft until their evidence and campaign accounting are retained. Independent PhysVal found two composition defects; both were corrected and rechecked at3f665f0.

Tasks: `TASK-CALO-BASELINE-RESTORE`, `TASK-CALO-EDM-IO`. Governing designs DES025/030–034/039/043; aperture proposal is reidentified ADR011 while its original ADR008 branch alias survives. The unresolved eleven-question #75 review is retained in `docs/design/inputs/ECAL-baseline-integration-2026-11-04.md`.

A separate infrastructure PR preserves exact historical token ownership, interactions, original heads, labels and supersession mapping. Active campaign counters remain excluded until their turns close. Follow-up tasks cover physical digitization, LAr HCAL parameterization, FCAL DD4hep/readout, connected services and complete detector qualification.

issues.title: Software: restore calorimeter EDM and EDM4hep I/O from PR #80
issues.body:
## Problem
#78–#80 were stacked PRs. #77 merged into `main` first, then #78–#80 were merged
into their already-merged parent branches, so none reached `main`. The calorimeter
code from #80 exists only on `origin/codex/software-calorimeter` (`f45e0a8`).
`main` has no calorimeter EDM, I/O or reconstruction code.

The physics there is a toy (threshold response, connected-component clustering)
and will be replaced by realistic digitization/clustering. The plumbing is worth
keeping.

## Scope
Keep:
- `software/source/EDM/` (hit/cluster structs)
- `ActsExamples/Calorimeter/EDM4hep/` converters, metadata, fixtures + round-trip tests
- Digitization/clustering algorithm wrappers as skeletons (I/O + config, no physics)

Drop:
- `CalorimeterResponse`, `CalorimeterClusterer` and their tests
- FastJet jets (restore later once clusters are calibrated)
- `externals/`, `detectors/` relocation, #78/#79 Makefiles and ACTS project hook

Build:
- Replace the #79 ACTS hook with a standalone CMake project following
  `software/source/ActsExamples/TrackerGbts/CMakeLists.txt`
- Same ACTS pin `355ea684`, EDM4hep/podio from the existing Spack env

Out of scope: EDM extensions, realistic response, topo-clustering/CLUE, cellID service.

## Done when
- [ ] Builds on `main` against the pinned ACTS
- [ ] EDM4hep hit/cluster round-trip tests pass
- [ ] No toy physics left; no tracker paths changed
- [ ] AGENTS.md records (session log, interactions, tracking) updated

The human requested a single main-targeted replacement for ECAL PR70/71/73/74/75,
including issue114 EDM support; a separate infrastructure PR preserving work,
tokens, interactions and labels; and refreshed HCAL/FCAL baseline design PRs.
The target is two ECAL-distinguished working baseline detectors with an initial
limited digitization interface, followed by physical response work.

The explicit implementation request authorizes this bounded restoration despite
the older M0/prototype default. No design lifecycle is advanced to sign-off or
acceptance. SysArch established that HCAL regions remain analytical and FCAL is
ROOT-only. The delivered selector records those design stages and constructs
actual maintained tracker+ECAL geometry; full detector/response qualification is
tracked separately rather than claimed.
